# cr-ci set-secrets.sh (dry-run) project=example-project region=us-central1
# dry-run: nothing is changed; '?' lines are read-only checks, assumed to find nothing
# C5/C9: generated webhook secret -> cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret
# would write 32 random bytes as 64 hex chars (no newline) to new-webhook-secret, mode 0600
+ gcloud secrets versions add cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --project=example-project --data-file=- --format=none < new-webhook-secret
# paste the content of new-webhook-secret into the GitHub App's webhook secret, then delete new-webhook-secret
# done
